annotation.kind: source selection, tier label, ordered low-rank matrix-vector execution, and exact finite forms of Lemma 3.1 equations (3.1)-(3.2)

assumptions: A is a real b-by-b matrix, X and Y are real b-by-r matrices, and v is a real length-b vector.
X has orthonormal columns and Atilde = X Y^T = A + truncError.
The low-rank approximation satisfies ||truncError||_F <= epsilon * beta with epsilon > 0 and beta > 0.
Unit roundoff u is positive and smaller than epsilon, and gamma_c is valid for c = b + r^(3/2).
The computation is ordered as wHat = fl(Y^T v) followed by zHat = fl(X wHat).
The two stages carry the standard backward perturbations ||deltaY||_F <= gamma_b ||Y||_F and ||deltaX||_F <= gamma_r ||X||_F.
The real-valued standard model excludes overflow, underflow, NaNs, and infinities.

conditions.L: The identical fixed statement and P15 shared files are present; the frozen NumStability library is also present.
conditions.N: The fixed statement and P15 shared files are present; no NumStability artifact is present.

formal_statement.lean_header: theorem p15_t2_low_rank_matvec_backward_error {b r : Nat} (run : P15LowRankMatVecExecution b r) : let Atilde := p15LowRankMatrix run.X run.Y; let deltaAtilde := p15LowRankRoundingError run; let deltaA := p15LowRankTotalError run; let gammaC := p15GammaReal (p15LowRankKernelCost b r) run.unitRoundoff; run.zHat = p15MatVec (Atilde + deltaAtilde) run.v and p15FrobNorm deltaAtilde <= gammaC * p15FrobNorm Atilde and deltaA = run.truncError + deltaAtilde and run.zHat = p15MatVec (run.A + deltaA) run.v and p15FrobNorm deltaA <= gammaC * p15FrobNorm run.A + run.epsilon * (1 + gammaC) * run.beta and gammaC * p15FrobNorm run.A + run.epsilon * (1 + gammaC) * run.beta = gammaC * p15FrobNorm run.A + run.epsilon * run.beta + run.epsilon * gammaC * run.beta
formal_statement.plain_language: The ordered floating-point computation X(Y^T v) has the equation (3.1) backward perturbation relative to Atilde = X Y^T and, after adding the low-rank truncation error, the exact equation (3.2) perturbation relative to A, including the mixed epsilon-gamma term.

informal_proof: Expand (X + deltaX)(Y + deltaY)^T, use orthonormality to prove ||X||_F = sqrt(r) and ||X Y^T||_F = ||Y||_F, combine the gamma_b and gamma_r stage bounds into gamma_(b+r^(3/2)), then add truncError and use Frobenius triangle and submultiplicative inequalities to obtain equation (3.2) with its exact epsilon*gammaC*beta term.
informal_statement: The complete exact finite backward-error content of Lemma 3.1 equations (3.1) and (3.2), derived from the ordered low-rank matrix-vector computation before the mixed epsilon-gamma term is abbreviated as O(u epsilon).
